snippet.title: Potion Sort — Official Trailer | Cozy potion-sorting game (out now on itch.io)
snippet.description:
The witch's toad knocked everything over. You put the vials back.

Potion Sort is a first-person tidying game. Pick up each vial, identify it by its colour,
bottle shape and symbol, and put it back on the right shelf. No timer, no fail state.

Over a thousand vials, dozens of potions, 3 rooms, plenty of secrets.
Free demo available, and your save carries over to the full game.
Windows & Mac, €4.99.

itch.io: https://randomgamesstu.itch.io/potion-sort
